homePageSubtitle: Our long-term vision is to advance trustworthy long-term autonomy in mobile robotics, enabling robots to operate safely, efficiently, and adaptively in dynamic, uncertain, and previously unexplored environments, while bridging theoretical innovations and reliable real-world deployment.

homePageBlocks.title: Team
homePageBlocks.subtitle: Our team includes faculty members, graduate students, and researchers working together on robotics and autonomous systems. Visit our team page to learn more about who we are and what we do.

homePageBlocks.title: Publications
homePageBlocks.subtitle: Explore the latest research from the Robot Autonomy Lab. Our team publishes journal articles and conference papers on robotics and autonomous systems. Visit our publications page to learn more.

homePageBlocks.title: Apply
homePageBlocks.subtitle: Interested in robotics and AI? We’re looking for motivated students and researchers to work with us on exciting AI-driven robotics projects. Visit our Join Us page to see current opportunities and learn how to apply.

homePageBlocks.title: Teaching
homePageBlocks.subtitle: Dr. Wang teaches courses on robotics and autonomous systems at the University of Manitoba. Visit the Teaching page to learn more about these course.
